items.description:
Denel Mechem began life as the Applied Chemistry Unit of the CSIR, researching mechanical and chemical solutions to defence problems, before growing into a global name in demining, explosive remnants of war clearance and canine detection services. Its vehicle division designs, manufactures and tests mine-protected vehicles, among them the Casspir and Mamba, which have seen service with armed forces and peacekeeping missions well beyond South Africa, while its canine services train and deploy detection dogs for mine, explosive and drug detection work.

Mechem takes a toolbox approach to demining, combining different technologies, vehicles and trained dogs depending on the terrain and threat involved, backed by decades of field experience clearing former conflict zones. Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, the company has carried out demining and explosive-detection training work in countries including Angola and Namibia, giving it a track record that spans both local manufacturing and deployment in some of the world's most demanding environments.

JHPE Precision Engineering is an ISO 9001:2015 accredited high-precision manufacturing company established in 2001, specialising in CNC milling with a 4th axis, CNC turning and wire eroding across a wide range of materials including titanium, aluminium, stainless steels and engineering plastics. Its Lyttelton Manor facility houses 30 CNC machines alongside a dedicated inspection area with two Carl Zeiss CMM machines and a designated polishing area, and the company also offers laser marking and anodising services.

Working two shifts to increase capacity and shorten lead times, JHPE serves clients mainly in the dental, medical and other precision industries, both locally and internationally, manufacturing components to fine tolerance restraints. The company aims to provide a one-stop solution by sourcing additional requirements it doesn't offer directly, such as heat treatment and surface treatments, making it a fit for clients who need precision parts manufactured and finished without managing multiple suppliers themselves.

Lesira Manufacturing, trading as Lesira-Teq, is a global original equipment manufacturer of smart prepayment water meters, ultrasonic telemetry and meter data management (MDMS) platforms for enterprise and municipal utility grids. Its proprietary single-SKU hardware architecture uses factory-embedded multi-carrier eSIM profiles and advanced 4G cellular bands to eliminate the need for country-specific manufacturing, with devices deployed across more than 600 networks in more than 180 countries.

The company's track record includes a national rollout for Botswana's Water Utilities Corporation, where 33,000 smart meters cut non-revenue water by 18% in the first phase of an aggressive national AMI upgrade, alongside deployments for Johannesburg Water and other private enterprises and telcos. Operating from Koedoespoort, Pretoria, Lesira-Teq also runs an approved channel partner programme, giving utilities and resellers a route to its metering technology through verified certification and direct API access.

items.description:
Malibu Country Lodge, on Reier Road in Kameeldrift East, offers accommodation, conferencing and spa facilities in a relaxed, natural setting near Roodeplaat Dam. Guest rooms come in Superior and Standard categories, each with a double or queen bed, en-suite bathroom, DSTV, WiFi and air conditioning opening onto a private patio, and two conferencing, workshop or meeting halls can accommodate between 10 and 110 people with packages customised to each booking.

The lodge's spa offers a range of massages and treatments, while its indoor and outdoor event facilities host everything from weekend getaways and corporate events to memorable private functions. Malibu Country Lodge suits overnight stays, weekend breaks and action-packed corporate getaways alike, giving guests a single venue for accommodation, meetings and relaxation without needing to travel between separate venues.

McCater Catering Supplies has supplied the hospitality industry since 1999, stocking commercial kitchen equipment and consumables across categories including storage and handling, clothing and linen, tableware, buffet and display products, kitchen utilities, cleaning and washing, heating and refrigeration equipment, barware and weighing scales. Its Equestria premises include a fully equipped demo kitchen where customers can see commercial equipment and new technologies running before they buy.

The business also offers turnkey kitchen design services through an experienced team, alongside free delivery to Johannesburg and Pretoria on orders over R1,000, and will source items outside its regular catalogue on request. McCater positions itself on personal service, attentive handling of customer requirements and competitive pricing, making it a fit for restaurants, caterers and other hospitality operators equipping or restocking a commercial kitchen in Gauteng.

Platō Coffee's Garsfontein branch is part of a coffeehouse chain founded in Pretoria in 2019 that has since grown into one of South Africa's largest, with around 150 locations across Southern Africa and the UK. The menu runs from house-blend coffee and espresso drinks to iced lattes, moccachinos and hot chocolate, alongside a retail range of pantry items, matcha blends and home brewing equipment for customers who want to recreate the in-store experience at home.

Platō also runs The Academy, offering courses from barista basics to sensory evaluation and home brewing for coffee enthusiasts and aspiring baristas. The Garsfontein café offers free parking and serves its coffee and light food for eating in or takeout, making it a convenient, casual stop for both a quick takeaway and a longer sit-down coffee.

Plexirenovations & Construction is a renovation and construction contractor working across Pretoria East, Centurion and nearby areas from its Garsfontein base, handling new builds, extensions, bathroom and kitchen renovations, full home renovations, painting, waterproofing and paving. The business publishes detailed guidance for homeowners on its site, covering topics such as NHBRC compliance, certificates of compliance, municipal building regulations and how to choose a renovation contractor, reflecting a focus on helping clients understand the process rather than just quoting a price.

The company takes on projects of any size, from a single room renovation to a full home extension, and positions itself around personally getting to know clients rather than treating each job as a one-off transaction. That combination of practical construction work and homeowner education suits Pretoria-area clients tackling a renovation for the first time who want to understand what's involved before committing to a contractor.

Plug & Play Energy designs and installs solar and renewable energy solutions for residential, industrial and commercial clients from its Lyttelton Manor base, covering everything from single homes to multi-tenant industrial complexes, retail environments, agricultural operations and solar farms. Its service range extends beyond installation to renewable energy feasibility studies, electrical engineering consultation, finance modelling, maintenance and operations, and performance monitoring and reporting, along with training for clients who want to understand their own systems.

The company keeps a close eye on new solar technology and pricing to keep its installations current and competitive, selling batteries, generators and related equipment alongside its installation services. Plug & Play Energy's Lyttelton Manor office trades Monday to Friday from 7am to 4pm, and its combination of feasibility studies and ongoing performance monitoring suits clients who want a long-term technical partner rather than a once-off installer.

items.description:
Vusela Risk Services is a South African risk management, security and consulting company serving clients in sectors including retail, logistics, finance and mining, with more than 18 years of experience behind its work. Its guarding services are backed by intelligence-driven insights and extensive databases, while its technical division specialises in high-level integration of CCTV, intruder detection and access control systems, supported by a national operations centre, AI-based virtual guarding and facial recognition technology.

The company also runs a real-time crime centre and an investigations unit covering fraud and theft, and has recorded more than 900 arrests in a recent 12-month period, including a peak of over 100 arrests in a single month. Based in Irene, Centurion, Vusela positions itself around combining experienced personnel with modern technology to protect people, assets and brand reputation, aiming to reduce vulnerabilities before they become incidents rather than only reacting to them.

Clicks Monument Park is a pharmacy, health and beauty retailer trading from Monument Park Shopping Centre on Skilpad Road, stocking medicine, skincare, haircare, makeup and baby care alongside the retailer's ClubCard rewards programme for regular shoppers. Online account features let ClubCard members track their rewards, review past orders and keep shopping lists, which can then be picked up at this branch or delivered.

Shoppers can also use the store to pay bills and prepaid services or track an online order placed through the Clicks website, giving the branch a role beyond walk-in retail. It trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm, Saturdays from 8am to 5pm, and Sundays from 9am to 3pm, making it a convenient stop within the shopping centre for everyday health, beauty and pharmacy needs.

CQ Accountants provides online accounting and tax services from its Hennopspark, Centurion office, using cloud-based software to service clients throughout South Africa rather than only locally. Its process starts with an introductory meeting to understand a client's specific needs, followed by a dedicated, personalised proposal and quote, with service packages tailored to businesses ranging from start-ups to well-established companies across a wide array of industries.

The firm compiles monthly management reports with insight and recommendations so clients can stay on top of their finances and tax matters while focusing on growing their business, and is registered with the South African Institute of Professional Accountants as well as SARS as tax practitioners. CQ Accountants' Hennopspark office trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and its monthly reporting approach suits businesses that want ongoing financial insight rather than service only at year-end.

Irene Arms & Outdoor is Centurion's firearms, ammunition, optics, outdoor gear and tactical equipment retailer, combining a modern retail experience with accredited firearm training and professional services for the hunting, sport shooting and everyday-carry market. The store offers finance options for firearm purchases, with competitive rates, flexible repayment terms and quick approval, alongside guidance on renewing or applying for a firearm licence.

Its facilities include 30m and 200m indoor shooting ranges, among the features that opened inside the Irene Link Centre in October 2022, where customers can train and test their skills in a controlled environment regardless of experience level. Irene Arms & Outdoor suits both first-time firearm buyers wanting informed, customer-focused advice and experienced shooters upgrading optics or expanding an everyday-carry kit, all from one site that combines retail, training and range access.

items.description:
Ompetha Power Projects is a turnkey electrical infrastructure contractor based in Raslouw, Centurion, delivering reticulation, fibre optic installations, and transmission and overhead line projects from 11kV up to 400kV. Its service range covers MV and LV reticulation, overhead lines and transmission, substations and switching infrastructure, fibre infrastructure, streetlighting and high-mast infrastructure, and ongoing maintenance and refurbishment work.

The company holds a Level 1 B-BBEE rating and a CIDB Grade 8EP registration, and backs its delivery with in-house systems built to bid and execute competitively, quality assured through inspection and test plans, inspection checklists and audits from clients or its own SHEQ department. Its project work includes the electrification of a large residential development in South Hills, Johannesburg, covering MV/LV reticulation, service connections, street lighting and ongoing network maintenance, giving Ompetha a track record on both greenfield infrastructure and long-term asset upkeep.

PostNet Sinoville, on Braam Pretorius Street at Sinoville Corner, handles the courier, printing and business services PostNet branches are known for, giving customers in the area a local point for sending parcels or documents and getting print jobs done without travelling into central Pretoria. As part of the national PostNet network, the branch also serves as a DHL Service Point, so customers can collect international parcels locally rather than travelling to a dedicated DHL depot.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed Sundays and public holidays, giving it hours that suit both weekday business errands and Saturday-morning collections. PostNet Sinoville's combination of courier, printing and parcel-collection services under one roof makes it a practical stop for both individuals and small businesses handling regular postal and printing needs.

No search results were returned to resolve the ambiguity, so nothing could be safely confirmed about this specific business.

items.description:
Cairnmead Health & Safety Consultants has worked in health and safety consulting for more than 30 years, turning complex occupational health and safety (OHS) compliance into practical, on-site solutions through three specialised divisions. Operational Consultants builds risk assessments, conducts audits, develops emergency plans, manages compliance files and implements evacuation systems, while Industrial Consultants supports the practical application of the Occupational Health and Safety Act on construction and industrial sites through audits, risk assessments and project monitoring.

The company's Faculty of Safety delivers accredited, CPD-bearing courses that help professionals gain qualifications in health and safety, turning legislation into site-level solutions its clients can act on directly. Operating from Waterkloof Corporate Park and serving Pretoria, Cape Town and Durban, Cairnmead positions itself as a benchmark-setter across the built environment, aiming to protect people, projects and performance through structured consulting rather than one-off compliance checks.

Capital Software is a payments and software technology company based in Hennopspark, Centurion, trading as a Reserve Bank-regulated Third Party Payments Processor and Systems Operator. Its product range includes Profits accounting and payroll software, the SlicPay digital wallet, the Capital Money Card prepaid card, and the Emerald and Extend product lines, giving corporate and public-sector clients a bundled set of payment, payroll and prepaid card tools from a single provider.

Operating since 1968, the company has built a long track record in South African payments infrastructure, a sector where regulatory approval and payment-network relationships take years to establish. Based at The Capital building in Hennopspark, Capital Software suits organisations that want payroll, accounting and payment processing handled by one established, regulated technology provider rather than stitching together several separate systems.

items.description:
Data4Every1 is a business solutions company operating from Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, supporting businesses since 2018 with automation, systems development, payroll, infrastructure and data and analytics services. Partnering with technology providers including Microsoft and Sage, the company delivers ERP systems such as Dynamics 365 Business Central, cybersecurity services, business intelligence and reporting dashboards, workflow automation, payroll and HR solutions, and farm management software for agricultural clients.

Customer feedback highlighted on the company's site points to responsive support and user-friendly systems, from payroll implementations to smart invoicing rollouts, backed by IT training courses the company also sells. With an additional presence in Zambia, Data4Every1 positions itself as a practical partner for businesses that want their systems, payroll and data reporting handled by one provider rather than several disconnected specialists.

Denel Pretoria Metal Pressings, known as PMP, is an integrated manufacturer of small- and medium-calibre ammunition, brass products, detonics, power cartridges and mining drill-bits, based in Pretoria West and employing about 1,000 people. Its product range spans military ammunition in both small and medium calibre, sporting ammunition for hunting and recreational shooting, escape systems for fighter aircraft and helicopters, and brass cups and discs used further down the manufacturing chain.

PMP holds ISO 9001 certification for quality, ISO 14001 for environmental standards and OHSAS 18001 for occupational health and safety, and exports a major portion of its output, making it a notable earner of foreign exchange for South Africa. Operating at Lotus Gardens as part of the wider Denel group, PMP has built a long-standing reputation supplying military, police and sporting ammunition customers both locally and internationally.

items.description:
MNF Steel is a steel service centre and fabrication specialist in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, established in January 2015 and offering both stainless steel and mild steel solutions with all cutting and bending done in-house. Its stainless steel work covers kitchens, food production equipment and medical and architectural fittings, while its mild steel manufacturing supplies structural and industrial parts such as machine frames, platforms, brackets, tanks, steel posts and bollards, and retail displays.

The business handles around 25 tons of material a month, with precision laser cutting, guillotining, plasma cutting, bending and welding services backing its fabrication work. MNF Steel serves homeowners, contractors, retailers and corporate clients alike, and with more than 20 years of combined industry experience behind its team, positions itself around fast turnaround times and support for smaller businesses that need custom steel work done professionally rather than compromise on quality.

Pro Arte Alphen Park is a recognised School of Specialisation focused on the arts, offering six specialised focus areas: Dance, Art, Music, Drama, Hospitality and Enterprise Management, alongside a full academic curriculum leading to matric. The school has maintained strong academic results over the past 20 years, giving pupils who want to specialise artistically the option of an academic matric at the same time rather than choosing between the two.

An adjoining hostel, Villa Nova, accommodates boarders, and the school runs an afternoon music academy offering musical training to outside scholars beyond its own enrolled pupils. Pro Arte Alphen Park also hosts an annual open day where parents and prospective learners can tour the facilities and see audition and placement information, making it a fit for families seeking a specialised, arts-focused alternative to a conventional Pretoria high school.

S A Business Link and Auto Repair is an automotive workshop in Hermanstad specialising in car sales and general repairs, backed by a Facebook following of more than 11,000. The workshop's repair side covers mechanical work, suspension and steering, body repairs, spray painting, brake and clutch services and vehicle diagnostics, positioning the business as a lower-cost alternative to dealership servicing for everyday mechanical and bodywork needs.

To make servicing easier for customers without a second car, the workshop offers a free local shuttle service while vehicles are being worked on, and trades Monday to Saturday. That combination of a broad repair offering, car sales and a shuttle service suits Hermanstad-area motorists who want one workshop for both buying a vehicle and keeping it running without the overhead of a franchised dealer.

The Union Buildings is the official seat of the South African government and houses the Office of the President, confirmed as the Pretoria address of the Presidency alongside its counterpart offices at Tuynhuys in Cape Town. Built between 1910 and 1913 on Meintjies Kop to a design by Sir Herbert Baker in English monumental style, the complex is known for its terraced, indigenous gardens that cascade down the hillside toward the city.

The grounds include a 9,000-seat amphitheatre used for state occasions and public gatherings, and a bronze statue of Nelson Mandela unveiled in 2013, which has become one of Pretoria's most visited landmarks in its own right. Open to the public around the clock as a garden and viewing site, even though the buildings themselves remain working government offices, the Union Buildings suit visitors wanting a free, accessible piece of South African political history and architecture in one site.

Beefy Treats is a healthy-snacks business at Fountain Square in Monument Park, producing biltong, nuts and dried fruit under its Beefy Treats, Nutty Treats and Fruity Treats brands. Orders placed online qualify for free delivery across the Gauteng region on purchases over R650, with the business distributing its snack ranges both locally and nationally by courier.

The company partners with the Pathways-Pretoria Studio NGO, employing young adults with disabilities in its packaging operations, giving its production process a social outcome alongside its retail and wholesale snack business. Beefy Treats suits customers looking for biltong, nuts and dried fruit snacks delivered to their door in Gauteng, as well as retailers and resellers wanting a supplier with an established distribution network beyond its physical Monument Park base.

Cendev Projects CC is a building and property development company operating out of Midstream Estate, Midrand, offering a full building service that runs from design and engineering through construction and interior finishing. Its work spans residential houses through to large-scale commercial property development, with the business describing its workmanship as built on attention to detail and competitive pricing alongside dependable service.

The company's commercial portfolio includes the Midlands Office Park and the extension and remodelling of the Midstream Spar, giving it a track record on both ground-up builds and retrofitting existing commercial space. Cendev Projects CC operates mainly across the Midstream, Midrand, Centurion and Irene areas, suiting developers and property owners who want one contractor managing a project from initial design through to the final finish.

Centurion Residential Estate centres on Centurion Golf Estate & Country Club, an 18-hole course designed by Peter Matkovich on a 160-hectare estate near Irene that blends parkland and desert-style holes with numerous water features to vary the challenge from hole to hole. The Country Club offers breakfast and lunch at the halfway house, afternoon tea, and refreshments after a round, alongside a pro shop and golf membership options including corporate golf days.

Its conference and function facilities vary in size and host anything from a birthday celebration to a wedding reception, giving the estate a role beyond golf alone. Although categorised among accommodation-style estates, Centurion Residential Estate does not advertise overnight guest stays; its focus instead is on golf membership, dining and functions for residents, members and visiting event guests within the Centurion Golf Estate itself.

DTP562 Group is a 100% Black-owned and managed distribution, logistics, development, facility services and construction company based in Olifantsfontein, Gauteng. Its divisions cover distribution and supply chain, construction, wholesale petroleum and coal sales, facility management, plant hire and security services, giving clients a single group to turn to across several distinct, infrastructure-adjacent industries.

The company describes its approach as built on exceptional people, a commitment to service excellence and an entrepreneurial spirit, with core values centred on commitment, quality, respect, honesty and accountability. DTP562 Group's spread across distribution, construction, facility services and security means it can support clients with a combination of logistics, built infrastructure and ongoing site services, rather than needing to coordinate separate providers for each function.

EMS Industries has spent 25 years developing and delivering embedded electronic engineering products from its Lynnwood Glen base, covering railway technology, power electronics and cell monitoring systems. Its railway technology range includes a well-established End of Train (EOT) telemetry system along with Head of Train units, remote displays and repeaters, while its power electronics division manufactures industrial power supplies and DC-DC converters built for tough operating environments.

The company's S213C power system provides locally designed 48V backup power for substations, telecommunications and control systems, supporting both new and existing installations with LiFePO4 battery options, redundant chargers and remote health monitoring to cut down on site inspections. EMS Industries also offers a cell monitoring system covering lead-acid, gel and lithium batteries across 48VDC to 440VDC systems, giving industrial clients real-time visibility and alarms without needing to physically check battery banks.

Lanino Traffic Markings formulates and produces road marking paint and products, including cold screed plastic, thermoplastic, waterborne and acrylic solvent paint, along with glass beads and a Delta retro-reflectometer for measuring line visibility. The business markets itself on local know-how, describing its paint as made by contractors for contractors, with products built to work under South African road and traffic conditions.

Based in Kameeldrift, Pretoria, Lanino supplies the road-marking materials used in both new line-marking projects and resurfacing work, giving road contractors and traffic-marking crews a locally formulated alternative to imported paint systems. The company's retro-reflectometer and glass bead products support the technical side of a marking job, letting contractors measure and maintain the retro-reflectivity that keeps road markings visible at night long after the initial application.

Quality Pools has designed and built swimming pools since 1965, now run by the third generation of the same family with more than 10,000 pools completed across its history. The business offers fibreglass, gunite and concrete pool construction as well as pool renovations and spa pools, with its fibreglass range manufactured using advanced marine technology and its concrete and gunite pools designed to individual specifications.

Operating from Montana, Pretoria, Quality Pools serves clients across Pretoria, Johannesburg and the wider Gauteng region, backing new builds with a 20-year warranty and maintaining what the company describes as a consistently high standard across six decades in the trade. That combination of long-standing family ownership and a choice of pool construction methods suits homeowners planning a new pool as well as those wanting an existing pool renovated or converted to a different style.

RussellStone Foods is a protein and processed-meat business operating from Monument Park under four brands: Creekside Farm for bacon, hams, sausages, pastrami and salami, Rica Meats for polony, russians and sliced cold meats, Pretoria Primal Traders for fresh and frozen carcasses, and a dedicated trading division supplying protein products both domestically and internationally. A factory shop at its Monument Park premises gives customers direct access to its range alongside its wholesale and trade supply lines.

The company manages its own cold chain from processing through to distribution, giving it control over product quality and freshness at every stage rather than relying on third-party logistics for a perishable product. RussellStone Foods suits both retail customers buying through its factory shop and trade or export clients needing a processor that handles everything from carcass to packaged product under one roof.

weDesiign is a design and digital consulting agency in Centurion working across brand identity, web design, software development, photography and marketing under one roof. Founded in 2020, the agency started out helping small businesses get a straight answer on what a website should cost, with early work coming through referrals and the results those referrals produced; it has since shipped around 1,000 projects for roughly 100 clients.

Today the agency operates from its own premises in Centurion with a hand-picked, specialist team across its six disciplines, taking on everything from startups building their first brand identity to established South African corporates rebuilding systems they put together in a hurry. weDesiign's research-first process and published pricing suit clients who want to understand the scope and cost of a project upfront rather than negotiating blind.

ACUDEO College Kirkney is an independent Grade R-12 school established in 2018 as part of the ACUDEO College group, serving the surrounding communities of Akasia, Andeon, Atteridgeville, Kirkney and Phillip Nel Park. The campus positions itself as an affordable, all-inclusive private school built around community-centred education supported by modern innovation, with facilities including science and computer laboratories, a coding and robotics class, sports courts and a swimming pool.

Beyond the classroom, the school works to contribute to its surrounding community by collaborating with local businesses, NGOs and parents, aiming to prepare learners as responsible citizens rather than focusing purely on academic results. ACUDEO College Kirkney has maintained a matric pass rate above 94% over the past three years, reaching 98% in 2025, making it a fit for Pretoria West families wanting an affordable private school with both strong results and a community focus.

EVA (Express Virtual Assistants), affiliated with Express Employment Professionals and based in Irene, Centurion, is an online platform connecting businesses with remote virtual assistants for hourly, pay-per-use support. Its EVAs specialise across admin and secretarial work, customer service, IT and graphic design, finance and bookkeeping, film and video editing, writing and content, human resources, and sales and marketing, covering tasks from diary management and data capturing to SEO, invoicing, recruitment shortlisting and social media management.

The platform screens, vets and trains every EVA before matching them with a client, and backs the arrangement with a guarantee alongside ongoing account manager support. EVA suits businesses that need specific skills on demand, such as bookkeeping for a few hours a week or a one-off batch of content writing, without the cost and commitment of hiring a full-time employee for each function.

Megavolt TV & Video has operated in Waverley for more than two decades, specialising in the sale, installation and repair of DSTV decoders and accessories, with services covering everything from new DSTV installations to ongoing troubleshooting. The business has more recently expanded into solar and power inverter repairs, adding an energy-related repair line alongside its original electronics focus.

Its electronics repair service also covers TV, VCR, hi-fi and microwave oven repairs, positioning Megavolt as a general repair point for household electronics in the Moot area rather than a single-product specialist. With new services continuing to be added, Megavolt TV & Video trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:45pm and suits customers who want DSTV, inverter or general electronics repaired locally rather than replaced outright.

Compubooks is a South African manufacturer, printer, importer and procurement partner delivering complete education solutions to government departments, schools, universities, TVET colleges and corporate organisations. Its product categories span curriculum-based textbooks from leading publishers, stationery, ICT equipment and accessories, educational toys, and laboratory apparatus, glassware and consumables for school and campus science labs, alongside furniture, sports equipment and custom branding.

Based in a warehouse at the N4 Industrial Gateway Park in Pretoria East, the company supplies in bulk at competitive rates, positioning itself on consistent quality, timely delivery and nationwide reach rather than one-off orders. Compubooks suits institutions that need one supplier for multiple categories of learning materials and equipment, from textbooks to lab gear, rather than placing separate orders with several different vendors across a province or the country.

The Employers' Organisation for Hairdressing, Cosmetology, and Beauty (EOHCB) is a constituted, registered employers' organisation under the Labour Relations Act, representing salon, spa and beauty employers in collective bargaining and dispute resolution since 1947. It represents members through conciliation and arbitration at both Bargaining Council and CCMA level, giving salon and spa owners organised representation in disputes rather than having to face proceedings individually.

The organisation also publishes regular guidance for members on labour law and workplace issues, covering topics such as what to do when commissioners overstep their authority, how to weigh upskilling staff against replacing them, and how to manage lockouts and picketing during industrial action. Based in Die Wilgers, Pretoria, EOHCB suits hairdressing, cosmetology and beauty employers who want ongoing labour-law support and representation rather than engaging a lawyer only once a dispute has already started.

EW Serfontein & Associates Inc is a law firm with a history stretching back more than 60 years, having originated from a partnership formed in 1949 before being established under its current name in 1999. The firm's practice covers commercial matters, company law, sectional title schemes, homeowners' association matters and insolvency issues, alongside conveyancing and civil litigation handled from its office near Lynnwood Road in Die Wilgers, Pretoria.

That location was chosen deliberately for its proximity to the North Gauteng High Court, the Magistrate's Court, the Registrar of Deeds, the Master of the High Court and the Companies Office, putting the firm within easy reach of the government and semi-government institutions its work depends on. With a second office in Knysna, EW Serfontein & Associates suits clients needing a firm that combines decades of institutional history with day-to-day proximity to Pretoria's key legal and government offices.

JJ Plates and Signs prints SABS-approved number plates for all nine South African provinces, available to order online with nationwide delivery or in person at its fitment centre in Wonderboom South, Pretoria. Plates are typically ready in about five minutes in-store, with professional fitment taking around fifteen minutes, and customers can also order and arrange collection or delivery by sending details through WhatsApp.

Beyond number plates, the business offers rubber stamps, glazing and doming, laser engraving, digital printing, sublimation, canvas and mug printing, block mounting, signage, safety signs, banners, pull-up banners, graphic design, business cards, flyers and key cutting, making it a broader signage and printing stop rather than a single-purpose plate shop. JJ Plates and Signs has built a reputation for more than 15 years on quick turnaround and straightforward service, with customers consistently rating their experience highly for fitment and plate quality.

Marcé Fire Fighting Technology has more than 20 years of experience in the supply, manufacture and maintenance of specialised fire fighting vehicles, including airport rescue fire fighting (ARFF) vehicles, mini, medium and major pumpers, water tankers, rapid intervention vehicles, grass fire units and 37-metre aerial platforms. The company produces up to 120 vehicles a year from its Centurion headquarters and a second manufacturing plant in Cape Town, and holds ISO 9001:2015 certification along with registration as a bodybuilder with the SABS and as a manufacturer, importer and bodybuilder with the Department of Transport.

Beyond South Africa, Marcé operates fully functional branches in Mozambique, Botswana, Namibia and Zimbabwe, plus an engineering office in Mauritius, while keeping around 98% of its vehicles locally manufactured. That combination of specialised vehicle manufacturing and an African branch network suits municipalities, airports and industrial sites across the region that need fire fighting vehicles built, serviced and supported close to where they operate.

Mariammen Temple, built in 1905 in the Asiatic Bazaar area of Marabastad, is the oldest Hindu temple in Pretoria and is dedicated to Mariamman, the goddess followers of Hinduism believe watches over smallpox and other infectious diseases. Its ornate gopuram entrance on 6th Street is widely regarded as one of the most striking examples of its kind in South Africa, marking the temple out among Pretoria's older religious buildings.

The temple serves as home to Pretoria's Tamil League and was declared a national monument in 1982, recognising both its age and its continued role in the local Hindu and Tamil community. Mariammen Temple suits visitors interested in Pretoria's religious and cultural history, offering a working place of worship that also stands as one of the city's oldest surviving heritage buildings.

Burgers Park is a botanical garden in central Pretoria, founded in the 1870s and covering four acres, making it one of the city's older public green spaces. It is named after Thomas François Burgers, the fourth president of the South African Republic, whose statue stands within the park grounds alongside a memorial to the South African Scottish Regiment from the Second World War.

Owned by the City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality and declared a South African National Monument, the park sits among a cluster of historic Pretoria landmarks that includes the nearby Pretoria City Hall and Palace of Justice. Burgers Park suits anyone looking for a quiet, historic garden in the middle of the city, combining botanical planting with the kind of monuments and memorials that give it a layered sense of Pretoria's past.
